info.title: AppSumo Deals API: Prices, Ratings and Vendor Websites
info.description:
AppSumo lifetime deals as JSON: deal price, list price, discount, rating, review count, star breakdown, vendor website, plan type and refund window.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/appsumo-deals (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Export individual AppSumo product cards with names, product URLs and their own summaries. Up to 20 results per request, as JSON.

searchUrls.title: Browse URLs (optional)
searchUrls.description: Leave out to read AppSumo's deal catalog. Or AppSumo browse pages such as https://appsumo.com/browse/?sort=rating: each returns the first 20 deals in that page's order, with card summary and category. Up to 20 URLs.

dealStatus.title: Deal status
dealStatus.description: current: deals on sale now. expired: past deals. all: both.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Deals for the catalog, or per browse URL. A request returns 20 rows at most.

201.description: The results, one object per row.

example.title: TidyCal
example.description: Book clients, sell packages, collect payments, and build your brand with one scheduling tool

400.description: The request body does not fit the input fields. The message says which field.
